candidate: H29e residual-structure audit after rejected one-macrostep synthetic program
purpose: Determine whether the directions missed by H29d have a transferable low-bit carrier, shared row/column frame, or phase-local structure before authorizing any hybrid.
residual_definition: r_i = u_i - P_J(u_i), using the identical H29d six-output mixed-Hessian/NS5 tangent and regularized 20-CG projection

global_carrier.discovery: joint-centered PCs 1 through 8 across all six nodes
global_carrier.evaluation: joint PCs 9 through 16 and every late/common/innovation residual without refitting

shared_frames.evaluation: left, right, and bilateral held-out energy capture

diagnostics.phase: rank-16 residual-row span transfer between joint-centered and late paths

routing_if_no_gate_passes: Close global-carrier hybrids for the measured residual and perform H30a multi-macrostep theory before implementation.
state_rule: Residuals, dense controls, empirical frames, and PCs are analysis-only and must not be serialized as a model basis.
